The following events took place in '''40 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
[[File:FinisValorum-NEGTC.png|thumb|[[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] begins his first term as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].]]
*The [[Supreme Chancellor election, 40 BBY|Chancery election]]; [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] becomes [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visit [[Vorzyd IV]].<ref name="Threat Within">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Threat Within]]''</ref>
*[[Sheeka Tull]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] split after their ship is attacked by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
*By this year the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] effectively controlled all Republic trade routes and hundreds of dependent [[star system]]s<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
